name: Sajin no Akhetaten
source:
14th Century BC, Ancient Egypt.

To curb the growing power of the priests of Amun, King Amenhotep IV began worshiping the sun god Aten, even renaming himself Akhenaten (Serviceable to the Aten).

The king's devotion gradually grew more extreme, eventually leading him to reject the traditional Egyptian pantheon.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/11801]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
公元前14世纪，古埃及。

为了遏制阿蒙祭司日益增长的势力，国王阿蒙霍特普四世开始崇拜太阳神阿顿，甚至将自己改名为阿肯那顿（为阿顿服务）。

国王的虔诚逐渐变得更加极端，最终导致他拒绝传统的埃及万神殿。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/11801]Novelgame[/url]]
